title: A Vector for the Orbit
author: Z. M. Brightwater
blurb: Theo Almeida, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
